title: Simulated trading session — 12 symbols, 24 h pre-historic + 24 h run

settings.deskWhy: Settings of the live desks (x01 / x02 twin) at 2026-10-02 22:18 UTC, without the live-execution block: stage gates min PF 1.05, every indication (focus empty = every combo, no kind disabled), every strategy toggle on, micro range off (minimal / short / general / long on at their defaults), no position or order caps, coordination off, signal sources at their defaults, signals validated on their own last 10 closes. Block as on the desks: overall mode, 8 levels, Active from level 2, ratio 0.25, max 4x, 3 steps.

checks.name: Σ hourly orders closed = total orders
Σ hourly orders opened = total orders
Σ hourly positions closed = total positions
Σ hourly positions opened = total positions
Σ engine + signals net = total net
Σ hour × type net = total net
Σ hour × source net = signal net
equity = balance at every hour end with no open order
orders inside the window (entry ≥ start, exit ≤ end)
order keys unique (cfg · symbol · entry → one unit each)

definitions.pf: gross profit $ ÷ gross loss $ of the closed orders (∞ = no losing order; the engine caps that case at 4)
definitions.net: Σ r × unit of the closed orders, $ (r already holds the 0.2 % round-trip cost, the Block multiple and the DCA legs)
definitions.ddt: drawdown time, h: the longest time the closed-order curve stayed below a previous peak (an unrecovered one counts to the end of the window)
definitions.ddr: drawdown ratio: the closed-order curve's max drawdown ÷ its net ($); – when net ≤ 0
definitions.maxDdPct: group: max drawdown of its own closed curve ÷ (start balance + curve peak); total: the equity curve (open orders marked to market every minute)
definitions.ddNow: equity drawdown time at the end of the hour: hours since the minute equity last stood at its peak
definitions.positions: symbol × direction episodes: overlapping orders on one symbol and side form one position (per group: episodes of that group's orders)
definitions.greenHours: hours whose closed orders netted > 0 (of the hours with closes)
definitions.hourBucket: an order belongs to the hour of its close (h, h + 1 h]; opened = entries in [h, h + 1 h)
definitions.subType: Plain = executed at ×1; Block Active = raised by Block at level ≥ 2 (with Block Active on every executed entry must be raised)
definitions.margin: Σ unit × volume ÷ leverage of the open orders
definitions.mtm: open orders marked at the last 1m close (price at minute t = close of the bar that opened at t − 1 min), less the round-trip cost; a DCA order is marked with its full final volume from its entry
definitions.unitPf: the same orders each at one unit of notional (r carries the Block multiple and DCA legs): the engine's PF, independent of the compounding equity sizing
